summary: Iteration 31 — full E2E testing of the four iter31 features (Licence-check history log, Vehicle History Pack, Records Retention indicator, Test History summary strip). Backend pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iter31_features.py: 10/10 PASSED. Frontend UI smoke via Playwright against the deployed preview URL: all four flows work as specified. Note: the sidebar labels the section 'Fleet' but the actual route is /vehicles — /fleet is not a real route (App.js has no such Route; wildcard redirects to /dashboard). Feature-level results below.

issues: Sidebar item labelled 'Fleet' navigates to /vehicles. The problem statement / task brief refers to '/fleet' — there is no /fleet route registered in App.js, wildcard redirects to /dashboard. If external links or docs reference /fleet, add a <Navigate to='/vehicles'/> redirect for /fleet.

action_items: (Optional) Add App.js route: <Route path='/fleet' element={<Navigate to='/vehicles' replace/>}/> so external references to /fleet don't bounce to /dashboard.
(Optional) Vehicles.js line 132 vehicle-history-button has no accessible aria-label — screen-readers only get the title attr. Consider adding aria-label='Vehicle history pack'.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py POST /api/licence-checks correctly syncs the driver headline fields (licence_check_date/licence_check_code/penalty_points/licence_check_due) — verified by pytest and UI.

server.py GET /api/reports/vehicle/{reg}: _norm_reg strips spaces & lowercases so 'ab12cde' matches stored 'AB12 CDE'. Unknown reg returns 404. format=json response contains 'title' starting 'Vehicle History Pack — <reg>' with >=5 sections; PDF (both include_files true/false) returns %PDF header. All good.
server.py GET /api/records-retention returns 4 categories with fields {label, retention_months, total, eligible, approaching, items} plus top-level totals — matches spec.
Frontend Vehicles.js: TabsTrigger value='history' uses data-testid='tab-test-history' (not 'tab-history'); matches test-history summary spec.

Frontend Drivers.js licence-check dialog: lc-date/lc-due/lc-code/lc-points/lc-result/lc-notes/save-licence-check-button/lc-history-item/lc-delete testids all wired; create+delete round-trip works and history refreshes without reload.
seed_data_creation: Pytest created one TEST_ prefixed licence-check on the first driver and deleted it as part of the test. UI test also created+deleted one licence-check entry. No lingering data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Re-run: `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_iter31_features.py -v -o addopts=''`. All 10 should pass. Frontend features live at /vehicles (not /fleet — that route doesn't exist, wildcard sends /fleet -> /dashboard). Retention card is on /dashboard below the Recall card. Licence-check log is on /drivers behind '+ Log check' link on each driver card. Vehicle history dropdown is on /vehicles Vehicles tab (row-level History icon). Test History summary strip is on /vehicles under the 'Test History' tab (data-testid='tab-test-history').
rca of the issue: No bugs found in this iteration.
